verdict.rationale: Marker's GitHub README says it converts documents "in all languages", which is a first-party multilingual claim. Nothing in the pack addresses CJK or right-to-left scripts, or shows fidelity matching English. missing for 10: explicit CJK support documentation, right-to-left script handling, multilingual accuracy benchmarks showing parity with English, independent or hands-on corroboration on non-English documents.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English

citations.quote: Converts PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB files in all languages
